threshold_selection: Maximum validation coverage with >=95% routed accuracy and >=50 cases
limitations: English BANKING77 benchmark, not a general multilingual helpdesk model
Scores are not independently calibrated probabilities
Coverage metrics apply score/margin gates only; inference adds lexical, context and sensitivity gates
Regex redaction is partial, not a privacy guarantee
Out-of-domain rejection is heuristic and only smoke-tested
Reference retrieval returns examples and labels, not verified answers or generative RAG
Urgency/team mapping is a demo policy requiring business approval
